target:
NARRATIVE: To check if a list contains consecutive numbers, I can sort the list and then check if the difference between each pair of adjacent elements is exactly 1. If any difference is not 1, the list does not contain consecutive numbers.

ACTION: {"expression":"not any((sorted(l)[i] - sorted(l)[i-1] != 1 for i in range(1, len(sorted(l)))))"}
